text: おなじ　ポケモン　おなじ　レベルでも　とるたびに　のうりょくが　すこし　ちがってて…　そだつと　ちがいが　おおきく　なる！

structure.jp: おなじ　ポケモン　おなじ　レベルでも
structure.en: even with the same Pokémon at the same level

structure.jp: のうりょくが　すこし　ちがってて…
structure.en: the stats are a little different, and...

structure.jp: ちがいが　おおきく　なる！

patterns.name: 〜たびに
patterns.explanation: たびに after a verb means 'every time you do it'. とるたびに = 'each time you catch one'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ちがってて is the spoken short form of ちがっていて: 'is in a different state, and...'. The い is dropped in casual talk. ちがってて = 'they differ, and'.

patterns.name: 〜と (when)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb says 'when this happens, that follows'. そだつと = 'when they grow'.
